verdict.rationale: Microsoft's FAQ states that codes don't require internet or data, so offline TOTP generation is documented first-party. The app also supports non-Microsoft accounts like Google and Amazon, and cloud backup to a Microsoft account is an optional toggle, which implies an account is not needed just to view codes. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no Microsoft account or sign-in is needed to use or view TOTP codes, and independent hands-on confirmation of fully offline (airplane-mode) operation.
